title: Reticular framework materials as versatile platforms for controllable polymer synthesis
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00749F, Review Article
Zhiwei Xing, Sai Wang, Qi Sun
This review summarizes recent advancements in using reticular framework materials as polymerization platforms. These materials serve as templates and catalysts for polymer synthesis, enabling the control of both primary and higher-order structures.
